correctness.rationale: A ground edge ab is geodesically covered by a selected pair of disjoint edges incident to a and b, respectively. This yields the exact min-degree and no-common-leaf condition. Edge-cover counting gives even perfect matchings and excludes the odd (n+1)/2 case; component surplus and cycle rank force K3 or P5 plus disjoint edges in every odd optimum. Each count has a unique labelled construction. Local exchange lists and the explicit three-slide transfer prove degrees and connectivity in all orders. The independently executable direct interval and structural programs check n=3..8 and n=3..9 as stated, without substituting finite checks for proof.

value.rationale: The triangular graphs are a canonical infinite distance-regular family. The theorem supplies an all-subset geodetic test and all minimum-set counts together with a parity-rigid mobility transition (even matchings frozen, odd optima slide-connected) and exact local degree classes. The leaf condition and explicit local transposition explain this structurally and add information not derivable from a previously known geodetic number alone.
